label: prop:upstream-mathlib-additions
title: Upstream Mathlib additions: complex dilogarithm via tsum + BW formula + Cl_2 oddness
html: The file upstream-mathlib-additions.lean provides three unconditional additions for Mathlib (see Table 1): (A) a concrete tsum-based complex dilogarithm complexLiTwo, a candidate for Real.dilog / Complex.dilog; (B) blochWigner, built from Complex.log and Complex.arg; and (C) the Clausen reflection identity \mathrm{Cl}_2(-\theta) = -\mathrm{Cl}_2(\theta), an unconditional Lean theorem.
